question:
Choose the correct one-word substitute for:

A person who believes that everything in life is determined by fate
solution:
The correct answer is '1' i.e. Fatalist .

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• A **fatalist** is a person who believes that all events in life are predetermined by fate and cannot be changed.
 
• The word **Fatalist** is derived from "fate," which signifies destiny or predetermined events.
 
• Other options do not align with the meaning of the word:
 
 
• **Realist:** A person who accepts a situation as it is and deals with it practically.
 
• **Idealist:** A person who is guided by ideals rather than practical considerations.
 
• **Pragmatist:** A person who is practical and focused on reaching goals.
 

Correct sentence: *A fatalist believes that everything in life is determined by fate.*

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• It is important to understand the meaning of each word in the options to select the correct one-word substitute.
 
• Word substitution questions often test vocabulary and comprehension skills.
